messages:
alinor (BD): Quick sync — NimbleAccel wants a private marketplace listing that bundles Reserved Capacity + SI integration discounts. Looping in @maria-pm and @leo-partner-eng to align on constraints.

maria-pm: Goals: predictable unit economics, bounded discounts, and a clear renewal cadence (yearly with delta adjustments).

jaya-sales: Customer asks: 12-18 month commit, 20-25% off in year 1, then at least 10% off on renewal. They want monthly usage true-ups. Feels standard but discount stacking needs rules.

leo-partner-eng: Note: Reserved SKU valid for hosted/dedicated only. For on-prem SI installs we must use a separate on-prem addon SKU (different billing flow). Also the SI is requesting an "integration credit" that they want to count toward commit — can we treat credits as committed spend?

steve-legal: Key points: (1) cap total discount stacking (marketplace promo + partner rebate + sales concession). (2) include a price-protection clause on renewals (suggest +/-5%). (3) define a 30-day post-period true-up and termination window. I'll provide a templated clause.

finance-ops-bot: Draft pricing sketch:

Reserved SKU: rwd-resv-4gpu -> list $120,000/mo
Partner bundle discount: 22% (first 12 months)
SI integration credit: one-time rebate, cap at 10% of commit
Renewal floor: 10% off list; price protection: +/-5%
True-up: monthly usage reporting, settle within 30 days

maria-pm: Operational plan: create two SKUs — (A) reserved-hosted-bundle (hosted/dedicated only) and (B) si-onprem-addon (invoice separately). Private-offer gating: allowed_discount_types = ["bundle","rebate"], max_effective_discount = 30%.

alinor (BD): Sales requests a minimum commit threshold of $250k ARR to qualify for combined discounts. Also asking for an early-adopter one-time credit for the first 3 customers ($25k each).

jaya-sales: Confirmed — early-adopter credit requested, limited to first three signups.

steve-legal: Early-adopter credits will be documented as non-recurring credits and will not change list price. Will include explicit language.

leo-partner-eng: Question: can marketplace billing report attribute consumption across reserved SKU vs SI-managed units for partner revenue share? If not, require manifest tagging (partner_tag, si_id) on allocations.

finance-ops-bot: Telemetry recommendation: enforce `partner_tag` and `si_id` in deployment metadata. Impact: ~1 FTE for ~2 weeks to wire billing filters.

maria-pm: Next steps and dates:
- Product: define SKU family and gating rules by Fri 04/09
- Legal: draft private-offer template + early-adopter clause by Mon 04/12
- Eng/Ops: confirm tagging feasibility and effort estimate by Tue 04/13
- Sales/BD: finalize minimum commit & initial customer list by Thu 04/15

alinor (BD): I'll coordinate with NimbleAccel and push for joint announcement only after first deployment succeeds. Require co-announcement review two weeks prior.

jaya-sales: I'll loop in channel partner manager and schedule kickoff. :thumbsup:

steve-legal: Drafting now, will post when ready.

leo-partner-eng: Will scope tagging work and post ETA by EOD tomorrow.

finance-ops-bot: Cost impact estimate queued.

alinor (BD): Thanks — flag blockers here otherwise we'll treat this as canonical plan for NimbleAccel bundle.
